<subject>URGENT - REQUIRES IMMEDIATE ACTION - Nordwind Orientation tomorrow @The Alsterhaus</subject>
<body>
Date: Thursday, 23 January 2025

Location: The Alsterhaus Conference Center

Orientation will be divided into two sessions arranged alphabetically. Sessions will run from 10am to 1pm and from 2pm to 5pm.

We strongly encourage everyone to attend their assigned session as essential information will be shared, and you will have the chance to ask any questions you may have.

Please bring your Nordwind Energie AG ID badge or a valid photo ID.

To speed up the process, please complete the attached forms beforehand, or you can fill them out on site tomorrow.

10am Session: Last names A-K

2pm Session: Last names L-Z


Registration will take place outside the Elbe Room.

Bus Transportation

Buses will leave from the Ilias Wagenknecht area on the ground floor of the north building at:

First session 				Second session
8:45am-9am				12:45pm-1pm
</body>
